name: fm-audio-record
label: FM audio record (headless)
description: All-native FM receiver that writes demodulated mono audio to /tmp/ferrite-fm-audio.wav. Source → Channelizer (10× → 240 kHz) → FmDemod @ 240 kHz → RealF32Decimator (5× → 48 kHz) → FileAudioSink. The demod sits at channel rate, not audio rate, so the ±75 kHz peak deviation is well inside the discriminator Nyquist; decimation to audio happens on the real post-discriminator signal where aliasing is not a concern. Designed for `ferrited --flowgraph fm-audio-record.json --source-type SoapySource --source-args driver=rtlsdr --run-for-secs 30 --start`.
ai_notes: Headless all-native FM receiver that writes demodulated mono audio to a WAV file. Like `am-audio-record` but for an FM station. No browser AudioSink — server-side recording only.
